title: feat(chatbot): confirm card for one record written from AI chat (cloud#3565)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP5qCsohzeY1qHxN6c2Swhw2)_

Refs objectstack-ai/cloud#3565 — the framework half of the ruling (maintainer, 2026-11-04): the AI chat creates ONE record or changes ONE record after the person confirms on a card. The cloud half is objectstack-ai/cloud#3574 (the `create_record` / `update_record` / `remove_sample_data` tools) and objectstack-ai/cloud#3572 (the runtime cleanup service); cloud's tool-name conformance test goes green when a pin round carries this PR.

## What changes

- **spec** — `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']`: −`draft_record`, +`create_record`, +`update_record`, +`remove_sample_data`. The lint test for AI tool references follows the rename (`create_record` / `update_record` resolve; `create_records` and `draft_record` are reported).
- **plugin-chatbot** — `detectRecordWrite` and `detectSampleDataCleanup` read the pending-action payload the cloud tools attach; the live mapper lifts `recordWrite` / `sampleDataCleanup` onto the tool invocation. `ChatbotEnhanced` draws the record-write card in place of the generic approval strip: the fields to write (stored → proposed on an update), the dropped fields with their reason, and the three fixed buttons — **Confirm** (approve → the write runs), **Open full form** (reject with a declared reason, then the host opens the form), **Cancel** (reject with a declared reason). After Confirm the card links the written record; after Cancel it says so. A `sampleDataCleanup` proposal draws the seeded tables and counts above the generic Approve / Deny strip. `useHitlInChat` now records which button was pressed (`decision`) and the executed `result`, so the card draws its own outcome instead of parsing the English status line.
- **app-shell** — `AiChatPage` wires the card: resolves the record's app from `/api/v1/meta/object/<name>` (`_packageId`, else `setup`), opens `/apps/<app>/<object>/new?<prefill>` for a create (`recordFormPrefillQuery`: scalars as-is, lists joined, objects as JSON) and the record's `/edit` page for an update, and rehydrates the card from stored messages.
- **i18n** — `chatbot.tool.{create_record,update_record,remove_sample_data}` and `console.ai.recordWrite*` / `sampleDataCleanup{Title,Irreversible,Absent,Edited}` in all ten locales.

Known gap, on purpose: for an **update**, Open full form lands on the plain edit page without the proposed values. `ObjectForm` folds `defaults` into `initialValues` regardless of mode, so a prefilled edit overlay would overwrite stored values the person did not change; a create is prefilled. Filed in the cloud report.

## Why

Ruled on cloud#3565: both agents write as the person under their permissions; the model never passes ids the person did not see; the confirm card is the only way a write happens; delete and bulk stay out of chat (the agent opens the record instead). This PR is the console's side of that contract — the card and the tool names — so cloud can register the tools against the spec registry.

## Revised 2026-11-04 after seat 2's review (head 37bfbad0)

- **The 「清理示例数据」 card says the rows cannot be recovered**, on every card: `sampleDataCleanupIrreversibleLabel` (default "Removed rows cannot be recovered."), wired from `console.ai.sampleDataCleanupIrreversible` (「删除后无法恢复」) in all ten locales — the maintainer's dependency note on cloud#3565 until the recycle bin (objectstack#3146).
- **`absent` is rendered** whenever it is above 0 (`sampleDataCleanupAbsentLabel(count)`, `console.ai.sampleDataCleanupAbsent`), and so is the new `edited` count — the recorded rows kept because someone edited them since the replay (`sampleDataCleanupEditedLabel(count)`, `console.ai.sampleDataCleanupEdited`; `detectSampleDataCleanup` reads `edited` as 0 when an envelope has none). Both are i18next count families with every plural slot their language selects (objectui#11445). Two card cases pin the three lines.
- **The spec changeset names the `draft_record` retirement's reach:** no skill in this repo names it (the lint test names it only as its control; two spec page fixtures called `draft_record` are page names), the one skill anywhere is the cloud chat's `record_drafting` skill, moved in cloud#3574; a third-party skill still naming it reports `ai-skill-tool-unresolved`. Still `patch`. The plugin-chatbot and i18n changesets name the new props and keys.

## Verification

From `ui/` (the vitest guard requires the ui root):

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/recordWrite-3565.test.ts \
  packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.recordWriteCard-3565.test.tsx \
  packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/useHitlInChat.test.tsx \
  packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/recordFormPrefill-3565.test.ts \
  packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.recordWriteRehydration-3565.test.tsx \
  packages/i18n
pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot packages/app-shell packages/i18n   # 239 files, 2598 passed, 13 skipped
pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
```

From the repo root: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` (no generated file changed), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts`, `pnpm lint` on the changed files (0 errors; the warnings are the file-level fast-refresh class every export in `plugin-chatbot/src/index.tsx` already carries), `pnpm check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`.
